description.value: A family-owned and operated motel in the village of Harrison Hot Springs, named after the Belgian town of Spa in tribute to its founding owner — a nod to the hot-springs resort tradition stretching back to Roman times. Situated steps from Harrison Lake with views of snow-capped mountains, the 24-room property sits at the intersection of outdoor adventure and lakeside relaxation. Two on-site restaurants (Basecamp Burger Joint and Picnic Cafe) offer guests a discount, making it a convenient base for cyclists exploring the Fraser Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms an active, family-owned motel at 140 Esplanade Ave in Harrison Hot Springs. OSM community field lists 'Chilliwack' but the property is in Harrison Hot Springs, a distinct municipality (Village of Harrison Hot Springs). Address corrected to Harrison Hot Springs per website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The motel is a legitimate, active accommodation in a cycling-friendly destination, but neither required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) can be confirmed from the website. Direct outreach is needed before listing.
